Moreover, it connects the digital ecosystem with the real-world ecosystem globally to provide a self-replicating stable ECO business platform.
 
SEED comprises three elements in order to complete the blockchain business platform. First is the SEED(Sino Eco Energy Development), which develops eco-friendly renewable energy projects in the real economy. Second is the SVF(SEED Vault Foundation), which merchandizes the projects developed by SEED through blockchain technology for token business. The third element is the STM(SEED Trading Market), which is the P2P exchange that allows the profit from the real economy to be traded to tokenized cryptocurrency. 
 
Currently, SEED has various projects in progress globally such as SBC(SEED Blockchain Center), which is the energy saving smart building with blockchain technology applied in Indonesia, SEED Potato Farm, which is a part of the food resources development project, and solar power plant business.

Quantifying and understanding carbon footprint of companies, facilities or products
Forecasting greenhouse gas emissions
Understanding current and potential policy impacts on companies from emissions and energy reporting to pricing on carbon
